caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level view of a calm lake on a clear day. Pine branches hang into the upper-left and upper-right corners while black letterbox bars border the top and bottom. A light-colored wooden dock extends from the rocky foreground into the water. A small motorboat is moored beside the dock, and a canoe is pulled up near its right end. A plastic-wrapped bundle sits on the shore between the dock and the canoe. The dock, boats, bundle, rocks, far treeline, and overhanging branches stay in place. The lake surface shows fine ripples and a faint diagonal line of disturbance that shifts position. The dark reflection of the trees on the right wobbles and distorts as the ripples pass. Patches of floating debris lie near both shoreline edges, while the mirrored sky and continuous treeline continue to fill the frame beneath the cloudless blue sky, and no camera pan or zoom is visible.
